# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 with faster color, shaping, and text-processing paths. It also fixes an image-decoding resource leak and adds .NET 11-ready WebAssembly native assets.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled renderer moves to Skia m151 and includes upstream maintenance fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded image subset decoding no longer leaks native resources** — SKImage.FromEncodedData with an SKData subset correctly releases its native resource on all paths. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and text operations allocate less** — Common SKColor conversions and parsing, tag parsing, HarfBuzz UTF-8 input, and glyph shaping avoid avoidable interop and managed allocations. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly assets support current .NET runtimes** — Includes Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries and exception handling support for .NET 11 WebAssembly workloads. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp improves UTF-8 input, tag parsing, and glyph-result access to reduce allocations during shaping.
